# WorthCalc (worthcalc.win)

> WorthCalc is a free set of browser-based "is it actually worth it?" calculators —
> membership break-evens, rent vs buy, EV vs gas, commute cost, subscriptions,
> installment APR, debt payoff, and budgeting. No account, no backend; every
> calculation runs client-side in your browser.

- All calculators are free with no sign-up. Inputs and results stay in your browser; nothing is uploaded to a server.
- English (default, canonical): https://worthcalc.win/
- 中文版: https://worthcalc.win/zh/
- Español: https://worthcalc.win/es/
- Français: https://worthcalc.win/fr/
- Deutsch: https://worthcalc.win/de/

## Money decision calculators / Calculadoras de decisión

- [Costco Membership Calculator](https://worthcalc.win/en/tools/costco-membership/): Compares Gold Star and Executive break-even spend, including the 2% Executive reward.
- [Commute Cost Calculator](https://worthcalc.win/en/tools/commute-cost/): Monthly and yearly cost for car, transit, rideshare, or bike, with optional time value.
- [Rent vs Buy Calculator](https://worthcalc.win/en/tools/rent-vs-buy/): Compares mortgage payments, rent growth, appreciation, invested down payment, and holding period.
- [EV vs Gas Car TCO Calculator](https://worthcalc.win/en/tools/ev-vs-gas/): Purchase price, subsidy, energy, maintenance, break-even year, and total cost of ownership.
- [Subscription Audit Calculator](https://worthcalc.win/en/tools/subscription-audit/): Total subscription spend per month, year, and over 5 years.
- [Cashback Break-even Calculator](https://worthcalc.win/en/tools/cashback-breakeven/): Whether an annual-fee cashback card beats a no-fee 1% baseline, including welcome bonus.
- [Installment True APR Calculator](https://worthcalc.win/en/tools/installment-true-apr/): Real interest rate behind BNPL and "0% installment" offers.
- [Latte Factor Calculator](https://worthcalc.win/en/tools/latte-factor/): Daily habit spend projected to yearly cost and future value if invested instead.

## More planning calculators

- [Personal Monthly Budget Builder](https://worthcalc.win/en/tools/budget-builder/): Normalizes weekly, monthly, and annual income/expenses into one monthly plan.
- [Car Affordability & Total Monthly Cost Calculator](https://worthcalc.win/en/tools/car-affordability/): Affordable vehicle price from take-home income after insurance, energy, maintenance, and savings goals.
- [Compound Growth & Savings Goal Calculator](https://worthcalc.win/en/tools/compound-growth/): Projects contributions, fees, and inflation toward a savings target, or solves the required monthly contribution.
- [Credit Card Payoff & Interest Calculator](https://worthcalc.win/en/tools/credit-card-payoff/): Payoff time, total interest, and the payment needed for a target payoff date.
- [Debt Snowball vs Avalanche Calculator](https://worthcalc.win/en/tools/debt-strategy/): Compares payoff order, total interest, and debt-free date across strategies.
- [Debt-to-Income Ratio Calculator](https://worthcalc.win/en/tools/dti-calculator/): Front-end and back-end DTI, and how paying off one debt changes it.
- [Home Affordability & Full Housing Cost Calculator](https://worthcalc.win/en/tools/home-affordability/): Home price estimate from income, debts, down payment, rate, taxes, insurance, and maintenance.
- [Mortgage Payoff & Extra Payment Calculator](https://worthcalc.win/en/tools/mortgage-payoff/): Compares the original schedule against extra monthly payments or lump sums.
- [Hourly, Monthly & Annual Salary Converter](https://worthcalc.win/en/tools/salary-converter/): Converts pay using real workweeks, unpaid leave, overtime, and bonuses.

## Guides

- [The Math of Warehouse Club Memberships](https://worthcalc.win/en/costco-math/): Break-even spend for Gold Star and Executive tiers and the 2% reward math.
- [Is Costco Executive Worth It? $3,250 Break-Even Math](https://worthcalc.win/en/is-costco-executive-membership-worth-it/): Verifying the $65 upgrade cost against the 2% reward threshold.
- [Rent vs Buy: The Assumptions That Actually Change the Answer](https://worthcalc.win/en/rent-vs-buy-guide/): Holding period, mortgage rate, transaction costs, and opportunity cost of cash.
